baseline.scope: Independent fresh Blender import geometry/motion witness check. Blender is not the authority for runtime morph normal shading.

Corrective GPU buffers, draw surfaces, bones and influence count are unchanged. Loading cost not benchmarked here.

source_witness_provenance.scope: Existing authored bones and surfaces remain unchanged. Any new private geometry/normals were captured from the immutable original before candidate packing; these are source-preservation observations, without a new authored-fitness or artistic-approval claim.
